subject: Invoice delivery and billing contact — e-invoice vs portal enrollment
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme-corp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery for Redwood contract RDW-2184

Hi Ben,

Hope you’re well. We’re getting ready to activate the contract for Q3 and want to confirm how Redwood will deliver invoices and what billing contact details you need. A few specifics from our AP team:

- Preferred delivery: e-invoice (XML/UBL) to our AP ingestion endpoint (invoice@acme-corp.com).
- PO inclusion: every invoice must include the PO number in the header and line-level matching.
- VAT: we need seller VAT/evidence on EU invoices and a PDF copy attached for our tax team.
- Remittance: we’d prefer remittance instructions in the invoice payload and a monthly CSV remittance file for reconciliation.

Can you confirm whether Redwood supports portal-first delivery (we can pull invoices) vs push to our email endpoint, and what lead time you need for portal onboarding if we go that route? Also send any sample XML schema you support so our integration team can review.

Thanks,
Sarah Lin
Head of Accounts Payable
Acme Cloud
[attachment: po-requirements.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery for Redwood contract RDW-2184

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear breakdown, this is helpful. Short answers first: yes, we support both portal-first (pull) and push delivery to an email endpoint; we also support SFTP and API push for XML/UBL. We can include PO numbers in both header and line-level mappings and attach a PDF for tax evidence.

A few clarifying points and suggested next steps so we can get the right operational setup:

1) Onboarding path:
   - Portal-first (recommended): your AP team is invited to our billing portal (read-only access) where invoices are posted daily. This gives audit trail, retry history, and built-in CSV remittance exports. Portal onboarding typically takes 5-7 business days once we have billing contact + tax entity info.
   - Push-to-email (fallback): we can deliver XML + PDF attachments to invoice@acme-corp.com; retention rules are standard PDF + XML attached to the outgoing mail.

2) XML schema and samples: attaching a sample-invoice.xml in this thread — it includes PO header and SKU-level PO refs. If you need UBL 2.1 vs custom schema call that out and our integrations team will adapt.

3) Remittance file: we can emit a monthly CSV remittance (standard columns: invoice_id, remit_amount, remit_date, bank_ref) and/or provide a webhook for remittance events.

4) VAT/evidence: we attach PDF tax evidence on EU invoices. If Acme requires a signed tax certificate, let us know and we can route to legal.

Next steps I propose:
- Confirm the preferred delivery method (portal vs push).
- If portal, provide the billing contact (name, email, legal entity name, VAT/EIN) and preferred AP user to invite.
- If push, confirm destination mailbox and max attachment size (we can gzip XML).

Looping in Kimberly to coordinate onboarding and Connor for integration details. I’ll draft a short acceptance note you can sign if you’d like formal confirmation of the delivery channel.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[attachment: sample-invoice.xml (xml)]

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme-corp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AP Team <invoice@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Apr 2028 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery for Redwood contract RDW-2184

Hi Ben — thanks. Portal-first sounds preferable for our team long-term; we’d like to be invited so we can start pulling invoices during the first month of go-live, with email copies to invoice@acme-corp.com during the transition window. A couple of items from tax that I’ll flag:

- EU VAT evidence: we need both the VAT number and the invoice PDF attached for our VAT reclaim process.
- Consolidation: we prefer one consolidated monthly invoice for entity ACME-US if possible, with line-level references for project SKUs.
- PO handling: we will send a PO for each subscription order; PO number must be visible in the invoice header and as a field for auto-matching.

Billing contact for onboarding:
Sarah Lin — Head of AP
AP Tech Integrations <invoice@acme-corp.com>
Legal entity: Acme Cloud, Inc.
US EIN: 12-3456789

We’re OK with an acceptance acknowledgement (short email) that Portal is the canonical delivery and email is a fallback during cutover — please include expected timeline and primary billing contact in that note.

Thanks,
Sarah
[signature: Sarah Lin / Acme Cloud]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Apr 2028 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Invoice delivery for Redwood contract RDW-2184 — Acme AP wants portal-first with email fallback

Kimberly / Connor — forwarding Acme’s requirements and their confirmation to go portal-first with email copies during cutover. Key asks: PO in header + line-level mapping, monthly consolidated invoice for ACME-US, attach PDF for VAT evidence, monthly CSV remittance, and an invite to invoice@acme-corp.com.

Can you:
- Kimberly: start the portal invite flow and confirm a timeline (5-7 business days quoted above). Please send the onboarding checklist and the invite link to Sarah once ready. I attached our portal_onboarding_checklist.pdf (small).
- Connor: confirm we can map PO header + line-level values and output a monthly CSV remittance file. Also confirm webhook/webhook ACK option and whether we can gzip XML attachments to reduce size.

I’ll prepare the short acceptance email for Sarah that lists channel = Portal (canonical), fallback = push-to-email to invoice@acme-corp.com for 30 days, and expected portal enablement window.

Thanks,
Ben
[attachment: portal_onboarding_checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Apr 2028 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Invoice delivery for Redwood contract RDW-2184 — onboarding plan

Thanks Ben — looping back with timeline and a couple of operational notes.

- Timeline: once we have the billing contact and legal entity (we have Sarah’s details in the thread), I’ll trigger the portal invitation. Portal provisioning + initial validation takes ~5 business days; full CSV remittance enablement and webhook configuration usually completes in one additional week if there’s no schema change.
- PO mapping: Connor confirmed on the side that our integration can accept PO header and line-level PO references and include them in the XML payload. We can also emit the monthly CSV remittance file with invoice-level and payment refs.
- Cutover plan: we’ll set Portal = canonical as requested and enable push-to-email (invoice@acme-corp.com) as a 30-day fallback window. After 30 days we’ll turn off push unless Acme requests extension.

Action items for Acme (Sarah):
1) Confirm the AP username(s) to invite (email addresses).
2) Confirm whether you want consolidated monthly invoice for ACME-US or per-subscription invoices (you said consolidated, we’ll set that by default).
3) Confirm whether your tax team requires signed tax certificates in addition to PDF evidence.

Sarah — once you confirm I’ll send the portal invite link (we’ll include a short guide) and Connor will share the webhook endpoint details and sample acknowledgement payload.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: portal_invitation_link.txt (link to portal invite)]
